scope_note: Sampled 4 templates: homepage, product (strata-01), collection (men-running-shoes), blog (styling-sneakers).

rows.result: Titles are present and unique on every template, but product titles (the largest template, ~1,516 URLs) are non-descriptive: e.g. 'STRATA-01 - DARK BEIGE/NAVY' (27 chars) with no product type, keyword, or brand. Homepage (63) and collection (65) run slightly over 60. Collection/blog titles are well-optimized.
rows.next_action: Rewrite the product title-tag pattern to '{Product} – {Type} for {Men/Women} | Off Limits' (e.g. 'STRATA-01 Beige/Navy – Running & Gym Shoes for Men | Off Limits'); trim homepage/collection titles to ≤60 chars.

rows.result: All 4 sampled templates have unique, in-range meta descriptions (141–157 chars), descriptive and not stuffed.
Exactly one H1 on all four templates (homepage, PDP, collection, blog).
No skipped heading levels on content templates. Homepage is H3-heavy (76 H3s under 8 H2s) from product cards, which is acceptable for a storefront grid.

Systemic alt-text gap. Homepage 55/113 images missing alt (51% coverage), collection 27/38 missing (29% coverage), PDP 9/27 missing (67% coverage). Blog was clean (1/20). Well below the 95% threshold on storefront templates.
rows.next_action: Populate alt text on product/collection imagery — map Shopify product image alt to '{Product name} {color} – {type}'; audit theme/banner images for empty alt.

rows.result: Every sampled page declares a self-referencing canonical that resolves 200; single host (non-www, https).
Key pages return HTTP 200; nonexistent paths return a genuine 404 (no soft-404).
